comments.text: A user builds a local full-cast audiobook generator on it; the lead author reportedly said the next version will have a state-of-the-art voice designer ([HN, 07.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49986598)).

MOSS-TTS 2.0 expected with voice design on par with ElevenLabs, hearsay ([HN, 23.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49823156)); an 8-bit mlx-audio conversion had a shape mismatch, since closed (mlx-audio #846, 17.07.2026).
